title: user.profile_updated (v1) — EventEnvelope.data
description: The user changed their own name, email address or phone number. Producer: identity-service, topic `users`. Says which fields changed, never their old or new values (spec Section 14.2: no profile data on the wire). Strict (additionalProperties: false) so any change to the payload is a reviewed contract change, never a silent one.

changed_fields.description: Comma-separated names of the fields that changed, in a fixed order.
